exclusions.source_text: Left ventricular ejection fraction ≥ 50% within 28 days before randomization.

History of myocardial infarction or unstable angina within 6 months before randomization, or symptomatic congestive heart failure (NYHA Class II to IV), clinically significant arrhythmia, uncontrolled hypertension, cardiomyopathy of any etiology or history of myocarditis.
exclusions.threshold: MI or unstable angina within 6 months; NYHA Class II to IV

exclusions.source_text: Spinal cord compression or clinically active central nervous system metastases.
HIV infection that is not well controlled.
